interface.signature: s1: str, n1: int, s2: str, n2: int -> int

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) <= 100 for s in [s1, s2]) and len(s1) > 0 and len(s2) > 0 and 0 <= n1 <= 10**6 and 1 <= n2 <= 10**6
preconditions.description: Both strings s1 and s2 are non-empty and have length at most 100. n1 is a non-negative integer up to 10^6, and n2 is a positive integer up to 10^6.

postconditions.expression: M == max(0, (n1 * len(s1)) // (len(s2) * n2) * n2) if (n1 * len(s1)) >= (len(s2) * n2) else 0
postconditions.description: M is the maximum integer such that the string S2 (formed by repeating s2 M times) can be obtained by deleting characters from S1 (formed by repeating s1 n1 times). This is determined by the ratio of the total lengths of S1 and S2, scaled by n2, ensuring the result is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all((s2 * M) in (s1 * n1) for M in range(0, return_value + 1))
postconditions.description: For every integer M from 0 up to and including the returned value, the string formed by repeating s2 M times is a subsequence of the string formed by repeating s1 n1 times.
The string formed by repeating s2 (return_value + 1) times is not a subsequence of the string formed by repeating s1 n1 times.
